player_prompt.intro:
Wena Mdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Isithombe sakho kukhona '{symbol}'.
Inhloso kukhomba ukungabi ngemidlalo yethu (kwa ngemuva, kwempumalanga, noma kwezintsimu).
Ukwenza midlalo yethu, wena UDLALI.
Ngenisa umdlalo wakho ngendlela '[4]' ukuvula isithombe sakho eselweni 4.
Kwena Mdlali {player_id}, wena '{symbol}' bese udadle wakho '{opponent_symbol}'.
